_comment: Village banter (R7.2), merged onto data/dialogue/opening.json's table by dialogue_runner.gd. Same shape, same no-branching rule (see opening.json's own `_comment_shape`): a line or two per villager, flavour only. No `give:` or `beat:` effects — these people have nothing to hand over and nothing to gate. `portrait` reuses trainer.png, the only generic human portrait art the project has; a bespoke portrait per villager is not part of this pass.

village_mira.speaker: Mira
lines: Morning! Mind the coop side of the square, the hens have opinions about strangers.
That barn's held every harvest since before I was born. Still smells like it.

village_oskar.speaker: Oskar
lines: Windmill's been groaning since the spring thaw. Nobody's got round to it.
You're the one staying with old Elias, aren't you? Whole square knows by now.

village_tam.speaker: Tam
lines: Careful on the yard fence, the post on the end is looser than it looks.
Good road out to the meadow from here. Watch for the bramblebun, it startles easy.
